en: Vintage monochrome postcard with an Art Nouveau floral frame around a street-view photograph. The photo shows a busy urban street lined with two- and three‑story European-style buildings, awnings over shopfronts, pedestrians walking, and several horse-drawn carriages. At the top, the city name is printed in Cyrillic and Latin scripts. Above the photo, there is bilingual text identifying the street.
